description: Use this when a group (trip, vacation, roommates, couple, event) has several shared expenses paid by different people and wants to know who owes who and how to settle up. Each expense can be split equally, by exact amounts, by percentages, or by shares. Returns each person's balance (paid minus share, summing to exactly zero) and the fewest payments that settle every balance to the cent, plus a CSV of payments, balances, and expenses. One currency per call: mixed currencies are rejected and nothing is converted. Does not send payment requests, move money, or remember the group; for one restaurant bill use split_bill.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for every expense, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP. Defaults to USD. Mixed currencies are rejected; nothing is converted.

expenses.description: Every shared expense. Example: [{"description": "Airbnb", "amount": 360, "paid_by": "Ana"}, {"description": "Gas", "amount": 90, "paid_by": "Ben", "split_among": ["Ben", "Chloe"]}]. Record a repayment already made as an expense paid_by the person who paid it back, with split_among set to the person who received it.

amount.description: Total paid, e.g. 360. Optional only for split exact, where it defaults to the sum of the amounts.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code if different from the top-level currency. All expenses in one call must share one currency.

description.description: What it was for, e.g. "Airbnb" or "Groceries".

paid_by.description: The one person who paid, e.g. "Ana".

split.description: How to divide it: equal (default), exact (money amounts per person), percent (must add up to 100), or shares (weights such as 2 nights vs 1 night).

split_among.description: Who shares this cost, e.g. ["Ana", "Ben", "Chloe"]. Omit or use ["everyone"] for the whole group. The payer is included only if listed.

split_values.description: Per-person values for exact, percent, or shares, keyed by name, e.g. {"Ana": 2, "Ben": 1} for shares or {"Ana": 45.5, "Ben": 14.5} for exact.

people.description: Everyone in the group, e.g. ["Ana", "Ben", "Chloe", "Dev"]. Needed when "everyone" should include someone who never paid. Optional otherwise.

name: settle_group_expenses
title: Settle group expenses
